message.content:
Moved `charge()`, `refund()`, and `validate_card()` from `checkout.py` into `payments/core.py`. `checkout.py` now imports from `payments/core.py`.

`webhook_handler()` was intentionally left in `checkout.py` as it is coupled to the Flask request object; moving it would drag the web layer into `payments/core.py`, defeating the purpose of the refactor.

Test results: 47 of 48 pass. `test_refund_partial` fails but this is a pre-existing issue unrelated to this change (it asserts a rounding behavior that changed in the 2.1 release).
